title: Payment Arrangement Payment Performance Standards — Cure Periods and Default Counts
content:
# Payment Arrangement Payment Performance Standards — Cure Periods and Default Counts

While a Payment Arrangement is in force, each kind sets the shortfall still treated as paid, whether the current bill must also be paid on time, the cure period after a due date, the extra cure days given while a medical certification is active, the number of missed installments that defaults the plan, and what becomes of the plan balance on default.

| Arrangement kind | Shortfall still treated as paid | Current bill must also be paid by its due date | Cure period (calendar days) | Extra cure days with an active medical certification | Missed installments that default the plan | Plan balance on default |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment Extension | $0.00 | Yes | 0 | 0 | 1 | Remaining balance returned to the service agreement and due immediately |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | $1.00 | Yes | 5 | 10 | 1 | Remaining balance returned to the service agreement and due immediately |
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | $1.00 | Yes | 10 | 10 | 2 | Remaining balance returned to the service agreement and due immediately |
| Extended Deferred Payment Agreement | $1.00 | Yes | 10 | 15 | 2 | Remaining balance returned to the service agreement and due immediately |
| Winter Protection Plan | $1.00 | Yes | 10 | 10 | 2 | Remaining balance returned to the service agreement and due immediately |
| Arrearage Management Program | $1.00 | Yes | 10 | 10 | 2 | Unforgiven balance returned to the service agreement and due immediately |
| Commercial Deferred Payment Agreement | $0.00 | Yes | 5 | 0 | 1 | Remaining balance returned to the service agreement and due immediately |

## Definitions

- **Shortfall still treated as paid** — the amount by which a payment may fall short of an installment while the installment is still treated as paid.
- **Cure period** — the calendar days after an installment's due date within which paying it prevents it from counting as missed.
- **Extra cure days** — days added to the cure period while a medical certification on the agreement is active.
- **Missed installments that default the plan** — the number of missed installments, counted after the cure period, at which the plan defaults.

## Reading the table (hypothetical plans)

| Hypothetical plan | Cure days available after a due date |
|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement, no medical certification | 10 |
| Extended Deferred Payment Agreement, medical certification active | 10 and 15 more, 25 in all |
| Commercial Deferred Payment Agreement | 5; no medical extension |
| Payment Extension | 0 |
